goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide combined head RMS normalization and RoPE-tail execution, including YARN and inverse rotation, without claiming standalone RoPE, projection, Q8, or route ownership.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with libdevice-linked RMS, YARN, and rotary math

covered_behavior: head_rms_norm_rope_tail_kernel per-head RMS scaling with RoPE applied only to the rotation tail
YARN correction dimensions, ramp interpolation, and attention scaling
ds4_gpu_head_rms_norm_rope_tail_tensor shape guard and launch surface
excluded_behavior: standalone rope_tail_kernel and remaining M14.4 RoPE or attention kernels
dense projection and Q8 conversion or matmul kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, and C CUDA removal

rust_owned_in_this_stage: combined head RMS normalization and RoPE-tail tensor validation
YARN interpolation and inverse rotation numeric validation
not_claimed_in_this_stage: standalone rope_tail_kernel and M14.4 RoPE or attention family
dense projection or Q8 conversion and matmul kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal

b300_execution.test_command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 cargo test --locked -p ds4-cuda --features cuda-oxide-backend -- --nocapture
b300_execution.command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 CUDA_OXIDE_BACKEND=/workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/rustc-codegen-cuda/target/debug/librustc_codegen_cuda.so CUDA_OXIDE_LLC=/usr/bin/llc CUDA_OXIDE_VERBOSE=1 cargo run --manifest-path /workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/cargo-oxide/Cargo.toml -- run --features cuda-oxide-kernels --bin ds4-cuda-head-rms-rope-tail-smoke

next_stage: M14.3c Dense F16 And F32 Projection Kernels
